svg.title: MikuSwarm context assembly
svg.desc: The context one agent session is built from, top to bottom: system prompt, diary, hierarchical summaries, compact and rich chat tiers, satellite runtime state with tail instructions, and the trigger message, followed by the session's own rollout. Colored brackets map each tier back to the span of chat messages it renders; older chat fades upward into the summaries. A right-hand column marks the frozen initial session context and the per-trigger agent session whose only output path to the chat is send_message.
svg.text: last 2 days of entries, from every room
a mascot for the outage… it should look pathetic
